name: Luna Tile
description: A hand-carved decorative tile featuring a crescent moon, dotted sky, and woven earth. Inspired by quiet nights and open fields.

name: Moo Ring Dish
description: A playful cow-print ring dish with a coral hand rising from the center to hold your favorite rings. Bold, fun, and utterly unique.

name: Cloud Candle Holder
description: A sky-blue candle holder sitting on a cloud-like textured white base. Perfect for tea lights and small candles. Brings a dreamy calm to any shelf.

name: Sunrise Egg Cup
description: Start your morning right with this cheerful egg cup. Hand-glazed in warm, sunrise-inspired tones. Perfectly sized for soft-boiled eggs.

name: Check Tray
description: A bold checkered trinket tray for your entryway, vanity, or bedside table. Catch-all for keys, coins, and small treasures.

name: Speckle Jar
description: A generously sized jar with hand-applied speckled glaze. Ideal for storing dry goods, utensils, or wildflowers. Every jar tells its own story.

name: Wild Garden Vase
description: A sculptural vase with organic curves and hand-painted botanical motifs. Designed to hold a single stem or a small wildflower bouquet.
